name: NeoHorse-1-4B
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from Qwen/Qwen3.5-4B (config.json max_position_embeddings 262144). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
attention_variant: Inherited unchanged from Qwen/Qwen3.5-4B: 8 full GQA layers (kv heads 4, head_dim 256) and 24 other layers, per the base config.json.
notes: ADDED 2026-10-23. A finetune of Qwen/Qwen3.5-4B (repo created 2026-09-05, licence apache-2.0), not a new base model: same config.json as the base, so the architecture block is inherited unchanged. Derived here: active_params_b = params_b = 4.206B because the model is dense (config has no expert keys); safetensors.total 4205751296 / 1e9 = 4.206, slightly BELOW the base record's 4.66 - the card claims a 4B track and the tensor count is 4.2B, so the delta is likely a dropped tensor or a different tokenizer tying, not a pruning. flops_per_token_active = 6 * active_params (inference-forward convention used elsewhere in this catalog). kv_cache_bytes_per_token = 32768 is the size of the BASE config (8 full-attention layers * 2 * 4 kv heads * 256 head_dim * 2 bytes); the other 24 layers are Gated-DeltaNet linear attention and hold a constant-size recurrent state rather than a per-token KV cache, so the true per-token growth is the 8-layer figure only. Recorded as a contender because it publishes a same-table comparison against its own base. Tension worth a reader's attention: its tau2-Bench base column (84.29) disagrees with the base card's own TAU2-Bench row (79.9, qwen3-5-4b record) - keep both, this record quotes the derivative's own column.
